DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: デビットカードのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to discuss your debit card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週、家具を一括で買います。いつもの一日限度を超えるので、その日だけ変更できるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家具購入日だけデビット一日限度を上げられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Next week I am buying furniture in one payment. It exceeds my usual daily limit, so I would like to know whether I can change it for that day only.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can raise your debit card's daily limit only on the furniture purchase date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 当行のデビットカードですね。購入予定の金額はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is our bank's debit card, correct? Have you decided the amount you plan to spend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見積りでは十五万円です。普段の限度は五万円で、口座には代金を用意しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見積十五万円と通常五万円と残高用意を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The estimate is 150,000 yen. My usual limit is 50,000 yen, and I have put the money for the purchase in my account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the 150,000-yen estimate and usual 50,000-yen limit, and say the funds are ready in your account. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 限度の変更方法と反映時期を、カード担当が確認します。変更後に元へ戻すご希望もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The card specialist will check how to change the limit and when it takes effect. Would you also like to restore the original limit afterward?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。買う日の後は、五万円へ戻したいです。戻す手続きも一緒に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入後は五万円へ戻す方法も尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. After the purchase date, I would like to return it to 50,000 yen. Please explain how to restore it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Also ask how to restore the 50,000-yen limit after the purchase. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ、その日の変更と翌日以降の設定をお伝えします。お買い物は店頭ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell the specialist about the change for that day and the settings from the next day onward. Will you shop in person?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 店頭です。支払う前に、お店がこのカードを使えるかも聞いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 店頭利用で店舗の対応可否も確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, in the store. Before paying, I will also ask whether the store accepts this card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you will use it in-store and also check whether the store accepts it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その確認もお願いします。ここではカードの設定についてご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check that too. Here you can consult us about the card settings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見積りとカードを担当に見せます。変更が反映されたことを確かめてから、買いに行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料を担当へ示し設定反映確認後に購入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the specialist the estimate and my card. I will check that the change has taken effect before going shopping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the documents to the specialist and say you will buy after confirming the setting has taken effect. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、カード担当の席へどうぞ。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please go to the card specialist's desk. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 焼きたてのパンをお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for freshly baked bread?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この食パンが欲しいですが、棚が空です。今日、もう一度焼けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 空棚の食パンの次の焼上りを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like this sandwich loaf, but the shelf is empty. Will you bake it again today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask when the bread on the empty shelf will next be ready. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 次は午後二時の予定です。何本ご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The next batch is scheduled for two p.m. How many loaves would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一本です。二時に来られますが、熱いまま切ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一本希望と二時来店可を伝え熱いパンの切断を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: One loaf. I can come at two, but can you slice it while it is still hot?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request one loaf, say you can come at two, and ask about slicing hot bread. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 焼き上がり直後は切れません。切ってお渡しするなら、冷めるまで時間がかかります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot slice it immediately after baking. If you would like it sliced, you will need to allow time for it to cool.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、切らずに一本受け取ります。二時に取り置きをお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切らず一本で二時取り置きを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will take one unsliced loaf. Could you reserve it for me at two?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to reserve one unsliced loaf for two o'clock. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本日の二時でお名前を伺います。受け取った後は、蒸気が抜けるまで袋を閉じ切らずにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: May I have your name for two o'clock today? After collecting it, please do not close the bag completely until the steam has escaped.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前は田中です。帰る時も押しつぶさずに持てるかごを用意してきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約名とつぶさない持帰りかごの準備を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: My name is Tanaka. I will bring a basket so I can carry it home without squashing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the reservation name and say you will bring a basket to carry it home without crushing it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一本を二時に、切らずにお渡しするご希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: So you would like one unsliced loaf at two o'clock?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。家で冷めてから切ります。今はほかの買い物を済ませて、二時に戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自宅で冷まして切り二時に戻ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will slice it at home after it cools. I will finish my other shopping now and come back at two.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you will cool and slice it at home and return at two. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご用意してお待ちしております。ご注文ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will have it ready for you. Thank you for your order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 噴水の案内をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to look at the information about the fountain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 見たいです。今は水が低いですが、写真で見た高い形にもなるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 低い噴水が高い形になるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The water is low now, but does it also form the high shape I saw in a photograph?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the low fountain also takes a high shape. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この噴水は、時間ごとに水の動きが変わります。次の回は十分後です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The water movements in this fountain change at set times. The next show is in ten minutes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十分後なら待てます。全部の回で高くなるのか、順番があるのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十分後の回を待ち動きの順序を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can wait ten minutes. Does it rise high in every show, or is there a sequence?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will wait for the show in ten minutes and ask about the sequence of movements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 低い流れから始まり、中央が高く上がり、最後に外側の輪になります。この図で順が分かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: It starts with a low flow, then the center rises high, and finally it forms an outer ring. This diagram shows the sequence.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 中央の水が上がる所を撮りたいです。風があるので、しぶきの届かない位置で見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 中央の高い水を撮影ししぶきを避けたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to photograph the water rising in the center. It is windy, so I will watch from a position the spray cannot reach.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to photograph the high water in the center while avoiding spray. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この線より外からご覧ください。今の風なら、こちら側のベンチの近くが見やすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please watch from outside this line. With the current wind, you can see well from near the bench on this side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ベンチの近くに立ちます。始まったら低い流れの次を待って、中央に向けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内位置で低い流れの次に中央を撮ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will stand near the bench. When it starts, I will wait until after the low flow and aim at the center.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will use the suggested position and photograph the center after the low flow. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次の回が始まります。音楽も一緒に流れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The next show is starting. Music will play along with it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 低い流れが始まりました。順番を聞いたので、中央が上がる瞬間に写真を撮れそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 開始を見て目当ての動きの撮影に備える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: The low flow has started. Now that I know the sequence, I think I can take a picture at the moment the center rises.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Watch the start and prepare to photograph the movement you want. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、噴水の動きと音楽をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27215-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy the fountain's movements and the music.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 駅の駐輪場の一時利用は、初めてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this your first time using the station bicycle parking for a short stay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めてです。列車に乗る間、自転車を置きたいです。料金は停める前に払いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 列車利用中の一時駐輪の支払時点を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to leave my bicycle while I take the train. Do I pay before parking?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask when to pay for temporary bicycle parking while taking the train. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この駐輪場は、帰って自転車を出すときに精算します。最初に、車輪を固定する使い方をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: At this bicycle parking area, you pay when you return and take your bicycle out. First I will show you how to secure the wheel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。前輪をこの溝へ入れる所までは、案内の絵で分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内絵で分かった前輪を溝へ入れる手順を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I understood from the instruction picture how to put the front wheel into this groove.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the step of putting the front wheel in the groove that you understood from the instruction picture. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 前輪を奥まで入れた後の固定を、職員が見本でお見せします。ご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: A staff member will demonstrate how it locks after you insert the front wheel all the way. Please watch.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今、輪の両側が閉じましたね。自分の自転車でも、固定された所を一緒に見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 固定実演を見て自分の車体でも確認支援を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Both sides around the wheel just closed, right? Could you also check with me that my own bicycle is secured?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After watching the locking demonstration, ask for help checking your own bicycle too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ停めてください。入りましたので、固定されたことを確認します。ご自身の鍵もお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please park it. It is inserted, so we will check that it is secured. Please also use your own lock.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 固定されました。自分の鍵も掛けました。帰りに使う精算機はどれですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 固定と自分の施錠を終え精算機の場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is secured. I have also put on my own lock. Which payment machine should I use when I return?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After securing it and applying your own lock, ask where the payment machine is. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出口の横の機械です。帰りに駐輪の番号を入れると料金が出ます。取扱いの案内はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is the machine beside the exit. When you enter your parking space number on your return, it displays the fee. Here are the operating instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号を写真に撮り、精算機の場所も見ました。帰ったらそこで料金を払い、解除されてから自分の鍵を開けて出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 駐輪番号と精算場所を記録し出庫時の精算と解錠の順を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I photographed the number and checked where the payment machine is. When I return, I will pay there, wait for the parking lock to release, then unlock my own lock and take the bicycle out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record the parking number and payment location, and describe the order of payment and unlocking when leaving. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご帰着時に案内をご覧ください。それでは、お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the instructions when you return. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約の相談にお越しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to discuss an appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住まいの相談を予約しています。乳児を連れてきましたが、相談室へ一緒に入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約した住居相談へ乳児同伴可能か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an appointment for housing advice. I brought my infant. Can we enter the consultation room together?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can bring your infant into your booked housing consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご一緒に入れます。ベビーカーはこの通路幅に合わせてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can enter together. We will guide you with the stroller according to the width of this passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。途中で授乳が必要になったら、使える部屋はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 授乳が必要になった場合の部屋を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. If I need to breastfeed during the appointment, is there a room I can use?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about a room to use if you need to breastfeed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ階に授乳室があります。相談の途中で席を外す場合は、担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a nursing room on the same floor. If you need to leave during the consultation, please tell the staff member in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 場所を今、教えてもらえますか。相談中に探す時間を減らしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相談前に授乳室の位置を知りたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you show me where it is now? I would like to reduce the time spent searching during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to learn where the nursing room is before the consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの案内図で、相談室の隣の廊下にあります。利用中の表示もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: On this map, it is in the corridor next to the consultation room. Please also check the occupied sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 位置が分かりました。おむつを替える台もそこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内位置を理解しおむつ替え設備を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand where it is. Is there a diaper-changing table there too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the location and ask about diaper-changing facilities. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 台は隣のベビーケアルームにあります。授乳室とは入口が別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The table is in the baby care room next door. Its entrance is separate from the nursing room's entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの入口を図に印を付けました。相談室へ進み、必要になったら担当に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二つの別入口を記し必要時担当へ伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have marked the two entrances on the map. I will go to the consultation room and tell the staff member if I need to use them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Mark the two separate entrances and say you will inform the staff member when necessary. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、お部屋へご案内します。どうぞこちらへ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will show you to the room. This way, please. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察を受ける方のお付き添いでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you accompanying someone who is seeing the doctor?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母の付き添いです。母は最初、自分だけで医師と話したいと言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 母が最初は一人で診察を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am accompanying my mother. She says she would like to speak with the doctor alone at first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your mother wants to see the doctor alone at first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 承知しました。お付き添いの方は、外でお待ちになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Understood. Will you wait outside as her accompanying family member?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。最後に薬の説明だけ一緒に聞くよう母に頼まれています。呼んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 薬説明のみ同席希望で後から呼んでほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. My mother has asked me to listen with her only to the medication explanation at the end. Could you call me then?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to be called later so you can attend only the medication explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人にも希望を確認して、担当へ伝えます。外の待機場所はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will confirm her wishes with her too and tell the staff in charge. Here is the waiting area outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 母にも今、聞いてください。私はこの椅子で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人にも確認を頼み指定椅子で待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please ask my mother now too. I will wait in this chair.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask them to confirm with your mother herself and say you will wait in the designated chair. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人の希望を確認できました。薬の説明時に、お名前でお呼びします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We have confirmed her wishes. We will call you by name when it is time to explain the medication.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の名前は山田です。母の名前と同じなので、下の名前も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同姓で紛らわしいため自分の下名も伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: My name is Yamada. It is the same as my mother's, so I will give you my first name too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your first name too because sharing a surname could cause confusion. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 下のお名前も控えました。呼ばれたら診察室の前へお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have noted your first name too. When called, please come to the front of the examination room.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。最初の診察は外で待ち、私の名前が呼ばれてから薬の説明に入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の呼出後に薬説明へ入る予定を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I will wait outside during the initial consultation and enter for the medication explanation after my name is called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will enter for the medication explanation after you are called. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、お母様を診察へご案内します。お付き添いありがとうございます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will show your mother to her consultation. Thank you for accompanying her. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何があったかお聞かせください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰り道で、つながれていない犬に追われました。けがはしていませんが、通学路なので心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: けがなしだが放し犬に追われた通学路の懸念を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: On my way home, a dog that was not tied up chased me. I am not injured, but I am concerned because it is a route children take to school.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report concern about a school route where an unrestrained dog chased you, although you were not injured. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 犬は今もその場所にいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the dog still there now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は家へ戻ったので今は分かりません。見たのは十五分ほど前です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現状不明と十五分前に見た事実を区別して答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I went home, so I do not know now. I saw it about fifteen minutes ago.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish not knowing the current situation from having seen it fifteen minutes ago. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 犬の特徴と、見た場所をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please describe the dog and where you saw it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 茶色で中くらいの大きさです。この地図の橋の東側から私についてきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 犬の色と大きさと橋東側の位置を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is brown and medium-sized. It followed me from the east side of the bridge on this map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the dog's color and size and point out the location east of the bridge. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 首輪などは見えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Could you see a collar or anything similar?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 赤い首輪は見えました。家の庭から出たのか、道にいたのかまでは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 赤首輪と出所未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I saw a red collar. I do not know whether it came out of a house's yard or was already on the road.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that it had a red collar and its origin is unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かる範囲で記録し、担当が対応先を確認します。犬に近づいたり追いかけたりせず、距離を取ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will record what you know, and the staff in charge will check whom to contact. Do not approach or chase the dog; keep your distance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今は家にいます。橋の東側と十五分前のことを伝えられたので、あとは担当の案内を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自宅にいると伝え担当の対応案内を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I am at home now. I have explained the east side of the bridge and that it was fifteen minutes ago, so now I will listen to the staff member's guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you are at home and listen to the staff member's guidance on the response. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状況をお知らせいただきありがとうございました。担当へ引き継ぎます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for telling us about the situation. I will pass this to the staff in charge. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒の表に書かれた文字について、ご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the writing on the front of the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 急ぎで届いてほしくて、宛名の横に急ぎと書きました。これで速達になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 急ぎの手書きで速達扱いになるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wanted it to arrive quickly, so I wrote 'urgent' beside the addressee. Does that make it express mail?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether handwriting 'urgent' makes it express mail. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 文字だけでは速達の受付になりません。ご希望の扱いと料金を窓口でお申し出ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The writing alone does not register it as express mail. Please tell the counter staff the service you want and ask about the fee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 速達でお願いします。封筒の重さも量って、追加の料金を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 正式な速達を希望し計量と追加料金を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like express mail, please. Please also weigh the envelope and tell me the additional charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request formal express mail service, weighing, and the additional charge. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この重さの場合の料金はこちらです。いつまでに届く必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is the fee for this weight. By when does it need to arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明日の夕方までが希望です。宛先の地域に、その予定で送れるかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 翌夕方希望と地域別の配達予定を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like it to arrive by tomorrow evening. I would also like to know whether it can be sent on that schedule to the destination area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State your wish for arrival by tomorrow evening and ask about the delivery schedule for the destination area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 配達予定は担当が宛先と受付時刻で確認します。到着を確約するものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff in charge will check the estimated delivery using the destination and acceptance time. This does not guarantee arrival.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。予定を聞いてから、この料金で出すか決めます。急ぎの文字はそのままでもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確約ではないと理解し予定後に判断すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. After hearing the estimate, I will decide whether to send it at this price. Can I leave the word 'urgent' as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show you understand it is not guaranteed and say you will decide after hearing the estimate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その文字が住所を隠していなければ、宛名は読めます。速達の表示はこちらでご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: If that writing does not obscure the address, the addressee can be read. We will explain the express mail marking here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住所は隠れていません。担当に宛先を見てもらい、正式な速達の扱いを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛名は読めると伝え正式な表示と扱いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: The address is not obscured. I will have the staff member check the destination and discuss formal express mail service.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the addressee is readable and discuss the formal marking and service. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、確認担当へどうぞ。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please go to the staff member who will check it. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 納付書のお支払いですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are paying payment slips, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三枚あります。二枚は今月分ですが、一枚は先月分で期限が過ぎています。こちらで払えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三納付書のうち期限超過一枚の支払可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have three. Two are for this month, but one is for last month and is past its deadline. Can I pay it here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can pay the overdue one among three payment slips. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お取り扱いできる納付書か、それぞれ拝見します。期限の過ぎた分は、この案内の発行元へ確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will look at each to see whether we can accept it. For the overdue one, you need to check with the issuer shown in this information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。期限内の二枚は今日払って、先月の一枚は発行元へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 期限内二枚だけ支払い期限超過分は発行元相談と決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. I will pay the two that are within the deadline today and ask the issuer about the one for last month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide to pay only the two unexpired slips and consult the issuer about the overdue one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの二枚の合計はこちらです。現金でのお支払いでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is the total for these two. Will you pay in cash?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 現金です。この額を出します。領収の印が付いた控えは、一枚ずつ戻りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現金支払と各領収控えが返るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, in cash. Here is that amount. Will I receive a separate stamped receipt copy for each?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will pay cash and ask whether each receipt copy will be returned. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。それぞれの控えをお返しします。お預かりするのは、こちらの二枚です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We will return each receipt copy. These two are the ones we will take.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二枚を渡します。先月分は私のかばんへ戻したので、支払う分と分かれました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二枚を渡し先月分をかばんへ戻す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here are the two. I have put last month's slip back in my bag, so it is separate from those I am paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hand over the two slips and put last month's slip back in your bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お支払いを受け付けました。二枚の控えと、お釣りをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your payment has been accepted. Please check the two receipt copies and your change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚とも今日の印があります。お釣りも合っています。残る一枚の連絡先を見て、家で電話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二領収印と釣銭を確認し残一枚の発行元へ連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both copies have today's stamp. The change is correct too. I will check the contact details on the remaining slip and call from home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the two receipt stamps and change, then contact the issuer of the remaining slip. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お控えを大切にお持ち帰りください。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take care of your receipt copies on the way home. Thank you for using our service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: サービスカウンターへようこそ。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 午前中に買った袋を店に置いて帰りました。野菜とヨーグルトが入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 店に購入済み野菜とヨーグルトの袋を忘れたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I went home leaving a bag of things I bought this morning in the store. It contains vegetables and yogurt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you left a bag containing purchased vegetables and yogurt in the store. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お買い物の時刻と、最後に袋を置いた所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me when you shopped and where you last put the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十時半ごろです。袋詰めの台で電話に出たので、その台かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十時半の袋詰め台で通話した経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around ten thirty. I answered a phone call at the bagging counter, so it might be that counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you took a phone call at the bagging counter around ten thirty. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 忘れ物の袋を一つ預かっています。購入のレシートはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have one lost bag in safekeeping. Do you have your purchase receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。ここに品物が載っています。袋は青い布で、口に白いひもが付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: レシートと青袋の白ひもの特徴を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. The items are listed here. The bag is blue cloth with a white drawstring at the opening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the receipt and describe the blue bag with its white drawstring. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 特徴と中身を確認します。ヨーグルトは冷蔵品なので、受取後の状態もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the characteristics and contents. The yogurt is a refrigerated product, so please check its condition after collecting it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。見つかったからそのまま食べられるとは決めず、状態を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 冷蔵品の状態を確認する必要を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. I will not assume it is safe to eat simply because it was found; I will check its condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the need to check the refrigerated product's condition. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この袋でお間違いないでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の袋です。レシートの品物とも合っています。受け取ったら冷蔵品から確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋と購入品の一致を確認して受け取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is my bag. The items also match the receipt. Once I receive it, I will check the refrigerated items first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the bag and purchased items match and collect it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらをお返しします。お忘れ物にお気をつけて。またご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your bag back. Please take care not to leave anything behind. We look forward to seeing you again.
